title: strategy.compiled
description: PAYLOAD of the `strategy.compiled` envelope. Topic: campaign.strategy.compiled. Emitted by the strategy-compiler (§9.9) after it turns the CIB into a MediaPlan: a concrete campaign/adset/ad tree per platform with budgets, audiences, destination types, creative slots, tracking params and experiment design. Deterministic given CIB+config. The MediaPlan body is the frozen artifact media_plan.schema.json (§9.9); this event references it.

media_plan_id.description: Id of the produced MediaPlan (matches media_plan_id in media_plan.schema.json).

cib_ref.description: The cib_id this MediaPlan was compiled from (§9.9 pure function of CIB+config).

media_plan_ref.description: Pointer to the full MediaPlan artifact; validates against media_plan.schema.json.

summary.description: Thin routing summary of the plan tree.

creative_slot_count.description: How many creative slots the plan needs filled from DAM (drives the creative batch §15).

experiment_arms.description: Number of experiment arms = creative x audience-cell x destination (§12.1).

test_daily_minor.description: Planned test daily budget in INR paise.

min_viable_test_minor.description: War-Game minimum testable daily budget in paise (§13.4); if vendor budget < this the compiler returns insufficient_budget instead of launching (§10.1).

feasibility.description: Whether the plan is launchable at the vendor's budget. `insufficient_budget` means the campaign-compiler must NOT silently launch (§10.1, §13.4) — it surfaces options.
